title: Ranking candidate sites for a new cafe in Al Malqa, Riyadh

headline.label: score of the top café site, out of 1

service.name: Branch Site Selection for Food Service and Retail

data: OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20: the Al Malqa boundary, walking network, cafes and complementary places.
method: Candidates: nodes on primary, secondary and tertiary roads inside the district, one per 300 m grid square, 176 in all.
OpenStreetMap walking network at 4.8 km/h: 10 min = 800 m and 5 min = 400 m along the network.
Population: sum of WorldPop cells reached within a 10-minute walk, each cell joined to its nearest network node.
limits: A spatial comparison: it does not forecast sales and is not a feasibility study. OpenStreetMap may miss recent cafes or businesses, and WorldPop is a modelled estimate of resident population at 100 m, not a count, with no footfall or spending power. Rent, vacancy, parking and street visibility are not scored.
